title: Pi Workspace settings
description: Replaceable transcript, editor and workspace layout.

$schema.description: JSON Schema used by editors for this settings file.

transcript.description: Transcript backend: native, ledger, or a registered name.

editor.description: Editor backend: native or a registered name.

layout.description: Layout backend: native, sidebar, or a registered name.

minimumMainWidth.description: Main-area width below which the sidebar is hidden.

timestamps.description: Show available message and tool timestamps in ledger metadata.

durations.description: Show observed tool duration when both execution boundaries were available.

timeouts.description: Show available tool timeout arguments in ledger metadata.
